assessment.expectedMechanism: DocumentViewSet.download delegates to file_response. file_response resolves pk via global_objects with include_deleted=True, derives root_doc, checks has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", root_doc), then resolves effective file document and calls serve_file. A version query changes selected file_doc but authorization remains checked on root_doc. Archive/original selection is per selected file_doc.
